proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's uncle, whose true killer Peter hunts, then forgives.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Ben's nephew, who hunts Ben's true killer, then forgives him.

their_evidence: Spider-Man 3: Captain Stacy tells Peter and May that Marko was Ben's true killer and the first suspect only his accomplice; a vengeful Peter fights Marko; after the final battle Marko explains Ben's death was an accident and Peter forgives him. A flashback shows Marko's gun going off when the escaping crook grabs his arm.

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Harry dates Mary Jane, but he sees that she is falling for Peter, and it hurts him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Mary Jane's boyfriend, Peter's best friend.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Harry's girlfriend, who is falling for Peter.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: While Peter grows distant, Mary Jane leans on Harry as a friend, and they share a kiss she regrets. When his memory returns, Harry threatens Peter to force her to leave him, then dies in the fight to save her from Venom and the Sandman.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Mary Jane's old friend, who forces her breakup, then dies fighting to save her.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Harry's old friend, whom he forces to leave Peter.

proposed.title: Spider-Man 2
proposed.text: Mary Jane stays friends with Harry after their breakup. When Doctor Octopus kidnaps her as part of Harry's deal to capture Spider-Man, Harry tells Peter where she is held.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Her ex-boyfriend, still a friend. Tells Peter where she is held.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: His ex-girlfriend, still a friend. Kidnapped through his deal with Doctor Octopus.

their_evidence: Spider-Man 2: Mary Jane maintains her friendships with both Peter and Harry; Harry trades tritium to Octavius for Spider-Man and tells him to use Peter, Octavius kidnaps Mary Jane to coerce Peter, and Harry reluctantly gives Peter Octavius's and Mary Jane's location so he can save her.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Richard is May's brother-in-law, who leaves his son Peter in her and Ben's care.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: May's brother-in-law, Peter's father.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Richard's sister-in-law, who raises Peter.

proposed.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
proposed.text: Richard leaves young Peter at May and Ben's home and walks out with only "Be good." Years later May tells Peter that his father was a man on the run whose research was worth a lot of money.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Her brother-in-law. She tells Peter he fled with valuable research.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: His sister-in-law, who tells Peter what she knows of his flight.

their_evidence: The Amazing Spider-Man 2 opens with Richard at Ben and May's home leaving Peter with them; later May and Peter argue about his parents and she tells him his father was a man on the run whose research was worth a lot of money.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Mary Parker is May's sister-in-law, who leaves her son Peter with May and Ben.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: May's sister-in-law, Peter's mother.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Mary's sister-in-law, who raises Peter.

proposed.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
proposed.text: Before leaving with Richard, Mary goes over last-minute notes about young Peter with May and Ben.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Her sister-in-law. Leaves young Peter with her, with last-minute notes.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Her sister-in-law, who takes young Peter in.

their_evidence: The Amazing Spider-Man 2 opening flashback: at Ben and May's home, Mary tells Ben and May some last-minute notes about Peter before she and Richard leave.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Jefferson and Rio are married and raise their son Miles together in Brooklyn.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Jefferson's wife, Miles's mother.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Rio's husband, Miles's father.

proposed.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
proposed.text: Jefferson and Rio celebrate his promotion to police captain, and together they extend Miles's punishment when he runs off with Gwen. When Miles goes missing, Gwen promises them both she will bring him back.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: His wife. Worries with him over Miles.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Her husband, newly promoted to police captain.

their_evidence: Across the Spider-Verse: Miles is late to the party for his father Jeff's promotion to police captain; after he runs away with Gwen his parents extend his punishment; Gwen later promises Rio and Jeff of Earth-1610 to bring Miles back.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Laura was bred from Logan's DNA, and Charles calls her his daughter. Logan at first wants nothing to do with her, then gives his life to protect her, and she calls him her father as he dies.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: His daughter Laura, bred from his DNA.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Her father, who dies protecting her.

question: Laura's Logan is dead in this title (Wade digs up his grave; TVA footage shows Laura at his side as he dies). Laura tells the variant Logan that he reminds her of her father and that she got to grow up and have a life because of him. Add a stage for Logan and Laura here, or leave it because he is only remembered?

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Matt falls in love with Elektra, and they share their first kiss on a rooftop. Believing Daredevil killed her father, she fights him and learns who he is just before Bullseye strikes her down.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The woman Matt loves. Fights him to avenge her father.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The man Elektra loves, who she learns is Daredevil.

question: Matt never appears, but Gambit says Daredevil died fighting Cassandra Nova in the Void, Wade offers Elektra his condolences and she says "It's fine." Since a death is a stage, add one here, or leave it because he is only mentioned?

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: May and Ben are a married couple who raise their nephew Peter in Queens. Ben is shot dead by a carjacker, leaving May a widow.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: May's husband, shot dead by a carjacker.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Ben's wife, who raises Peter with him.

question: May learns with Peter from Captain Stacy that Flint Marko, not the first suspect, shot Ben. Ben is dead and appears only in Marko's flashback. Add a stage, or leave it because Ben is only remembered?
